maria: Heads-up — after the driver 536.x landed on prod-nightly I'm seeing a ~8-12% p50 regression for small-batch, seqlen=512 workloads. Uploading traces now.

aj: Can you paste the profiler output / top-line numbers?

maria: Snippet from local trace:
```
[profile] model=redwood-v1 seq=512 batch=1 kv_cache_hit=0.85
kernel picks (layer 1..24):
 - FusedLegacyAttn (previous baseline)   avg=3.8ms
 - HybridChunkedAttn (post-driver)       avg=4.2ms  (+10.5%)
notes: extra memcpy ~128KB per layer introduced during reorder
memory: resident +~9MB per worker compared to baseline
```

devon: Looks like autotuner now prefers HybridChunkedAttn for sm_80 when seq >= 256. That kernel path does a reorder -> temp buffer -> fused op, which adds the memcpy overhead. Autotune cost model didn't account for the memcpy alignment penalty.

samir: We also measured KV-cache behavior changes: alignment shift caused slightly different allocations and a small increase in cache misses (~+3%) for some workloads. That amplifies tail latency.

aj: Immediate mitigation suggestions: 1) runtime override to force legacy fused kernel for sm_80+seqlen=512, 2) canary rollback of driver on a small dedicated pool. Which is faster?

maria: For testing I forced the kernel locally and p50 returned to baseline. Env to force:
```
export REDWOOD_KERNEL_HINT=force:fused_legacy
# restart the serving process for the hint to take effect
systemctl restart redwood-serving
```

perf-bot: perf-bot: Canary comparison results (local): baseline p50=3.8ms, post-driver p50=4.2ms, forced-fused p50=3.79ms. KV-cache miss delta: +3% post-driver, back to baseline with forced kernel.

aj: Plan proposal — two parallel tracks: A) short-term: enable runtime override and push console toggle so SRE can flip for impacted fleets; B) medium: staged rollback of driver on Dedicated pools if override is insufficient. Canary in eu-west-1 at low qps first.

samir: I can run the staged rollback. Timeline: canary (eu-west-1) 2100 UTC today, monitor for 30m, widen to us-west over 1h if OK, full Dedicated roll within 4h if stable. Rollback target driver image: driver-535.79 (pinned). I'll coordinate with infra to ensure image is available.

devon: Longer term fix: update autotuner cost model to include memcpy + alignment penalty and prefer kernels that avoid extra temp buffers unless net win > 2%. I'll draft an RFC / PR to add an alignment-aware cost heuristic (ETA: tomorrow). Also add a quick smoke test in autotuner CI to detect path flips after driver bumps.

maria: Action items: 1) devon -> PR to autotuner cost model (due: tomorrow). 2) aj -> runtime override + console toggle + quick docs (due: EOD). 3) samir -> schedule + execute canary rollback + monitor KV/mem/perf (canary 2100 UTC today). 4) ops -> add alerts for KV-cache miss delta and per-layer memcpy bytes. Ping me with results. :thumbsup:
